description: This file defines various constants used throughout the Eclipse Hono project, including protocol identifiers, port numbers, address strings, header names, and utility methods for managing user principals and connection properties within the protocol framework.

classes.name: Constants
classes.description: A utility class providing project-wide constants and methods for managing user principals and connection properties.

methods.name: getClientPrincipal
methods.description: Retrieves the HonoUser principal associated with a Record or a ProtonConnection, defaulting to an anonymous user if none is set.

methods.name: setClientPrincipal
methods.description: Associates a HonoUser principal with a ProtonConnection.

methods.name: copyProperties
methods.description: Copies relevant properties (connection ID) from a ProtonConnection to a ProtonLink.

methods.name: getConnectionId
methods.description: Retrieves the connection identifier from a ProtonConnection or ProtonLink.

methods.name: setConnectionId
methods.description: Sets the connection identifier on a ProtonConnection.

methods.name: isDefaultTenant
methods.description: Checks whether a provided tenant ID equals the default tenant.
